title: Follow up with your leads
summary: Everyone who claims becomes a lead you can message on WhatsApp, from your own phone.

steps.title: Open Leads
steps.body: Tap Leads in the bar at the bottom. You see everyone who claimed, as it happens. They're yours to follow up.

steps.title: See who's coming in
steps.body: "Coming in" shows the days people said they'd come to use their Tikka. Get ready for them, or send a short reminder.

steps.title: Start with Message today
steps.body: "Message today" shows the people worth messaging now: someone who just claimed, someone planning to come today, someone whose Tikka ends soon and isn't used yet, and someone whose Tikka expired before they came. Each has a message ready, which you can change before WhatsApp opens.

steps.title: Message anyone
steps.body: Next to any lead, tap "Message on WhatsApp". WhatsApp opens on your phone with your message ready to send. For someone who redeemed but hasn't left a review, the button says "Ask for a review" instead.

steps.title: Find people
steps.body: Search by name, or filter by drop, where they came from, or which Tikka they got. "Wants future drops" shows people who asked to hear about your next drop.

steps.title: Download your list
steps.body: Tap "Export CSV" to download your leads as a spreadsheet, for one drop or all of them.

tips: Keep messages short and friendly, and mention what's waiting for them.
Only message people about new drops if they ticked "Wants future drops".
If someone asks you to stop, stop. Respecting that keeps people happy to hear from you.
